title: retrieval search response, v0
description: The answer to one round: either candidate requests (the core serves them and calls the next round) or the final ranking, never both.

requests.description: At most limits.max_requests; refused in the last round.

segment_id.description: A candidate the core served in this search.

score.description: The plugin's score; hits are in rank order.

explanation.description: Why this hit ranks here, returned to the client with it.

hits.description: Best first, at most the request's limit, each segment once.

paid_calls.description: Paid calls made for this round (for example a re-ranking API).

cost_cents.description: What those calls cost; a search's total stays within the profile's max_cost_cents.
